scope: Identity-bound HCS startup timeline; no root-cause or GPU-success inference
findings: The same container emitted a silo-start event before its first application process failed with RPC unavailable.
Operation-pending results are asynchronous lifecycle markers, not proof of hypervisor failure.
Fresh bounded Application and HCS Admin queries returned no matching events; the System query reached its 40-event cap, so it is not an exhaustive absence check.
System events include LocalService and NetworkService registry-hive initialization entries; no causal connection to the RPC failure is established.
nextExperiment: Capture HCS operational events and containerd/shim diagnostics from before the first ordinary GPU application on a fresh VM; compare process-start timing and service-profile initialization against a successful fresh control. Preserve the first attempt and do not warm the image before measurement.
